📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste your text into the box.
  2. Choose whether to ignore case, spaces and punctuation.
  3. See instantly whether it is a palindrome, plus the cleaned text and the longest palindromic part.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What counts as a palindrome?

Text that reads identically forwards and backwards. With "ignore spaces and punctuation" on, "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama" is a palindrome.

Does it check numbers too?

Yes. Numeric strings like 12321 or 1221 are checked the same way as words.

What is the "longest palindromic part"?

The longest contiguous substring of your text that is itself a palindrome, found with an expand-around-center scan.
